row.notes: F1Tuning data-class vtable 0x145bfe030 slot 2 (reader). Reads every F1Tuning Min/Max (and LowerBound/UpperBound) key by name with Game_Read_VtfFloat into PLAIN floats (no XOR) at reader offsets +0x10..+0x1f4 (CarTuning +0x28..+0x20c, data object at system+0x18): ChassisCOMZ, differential (or the old DifferentialRearTorque/OffPowerMultiple form, x0.01 derived), engine braking, radiator, camber, toe, suspension height/rest length, ride height, springs, third springs, ARBs, brake pressure/migration/cooling/duct, tyre pressures and tyre spring/damping coefficients, aero drag/lift bounds, gearbox ratio bounds. Checks Min <= Max only (errno trace); missing keys keep the defaults. Proto filled per V1222
